# Nyxiontech PDF Tools

> Free, open-source PDF and image tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded: there is no server-side processing, no account, no tracking and no file limits. Made by Nyxiontech (https://nyxiontech.com), licensed AGPL-3.0. Also available as a Windows desktop app.

Use it at https://tools.nyxiontech.com. Each tool has its own page, listed below; the page opens the tool. Polish versions of every page are under https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/, where the app's interface is in Polish.

## Tools

Edit & sign:
- [Edit PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/edit-pdf): add text, white-out, highlights, boxes and images; reorder, rotate and delete pages.
- [Sign PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/sign-pdf): draw, type or upload a signature (white background removed) and place it on the page.
- [Fill PDF form](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/fill-pdf-form): fill interactive form fields, optionally flatten them.
- [Add page numbers](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/add-page-numbers-to-pdf): position, format, font, start number, skip the cover.
- [Watermark PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/watermark-pdf): text watermark on every page, diagonal or horizontal, once or tiled.
- [Edit PDF metadata](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/edit-pdf-metadata): change or wipe title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer.

Organize:
- [Merge PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/merge-pdf): combine several PDFs in the order you choose.
- [Split PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/split-pdf): every page, by ranges, or extract selected pages.
- [Organize PDF pages](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/organize-pdf-pages): reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete pages; insert pages from other PDFs.
- [Rotate PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/rotate-pdf): all or selected pages by 90°, 180° or 270°.

Optimize:
- [Compress PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/compress-pdf): lossless repack, or rasterize at three quality levels (best for scans).

Convert:
- [OCR PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/ocr-pdf): searchable PDF from scans or photos, Polish and English (Tesseract, on-device).
- [Image to PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/image-to-pdf): JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or iPhone HEIC to one PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pdf-to-jpg): pages as JPG or PNG at 72, 150 or 300 dpi.
- [PDF to text](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pdf-to-text): extract text, copy or save as .txt.
- [PDF to Word](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pdf-to-word): .docx with text, paragraphs, bold and sizes (not tables, columns or images).
- [Word to PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/word-to-pdf): .docx to PDF through the browser's print dialog (basic layout).

Security:
- [Protect PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/protect-pdf): AES-256 password and permissions.
- [Unlock PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/unlock-pdf): remove the password or restrictions from a PDF you can open (does not crack passwords).
- [Redact PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/redact-pdf): find text, preset patterns (e-mail, phone, IBAN, NIP/PESEL) or draw boxes; redacted content is really removed.

Review:
- [Compare PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/compare-pdf): text diff and visual diff per page.

Images:
- [Image converter](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/image-converter): compress, resize and convert JPG, PNG, WebP in bulk; strips EXIF.
- [Remove background](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/remove-background): on-device AI (U²-Net) or plain colour; transparent PNG.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/heic-to-jpg): iPhone photos to JPG.

Other:
- [QR code generator](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/qr-code-generator): link, Wi-Fi, contact card, e-mail or text; PNG or SVG; static, no tracking.

Polish pages (strony po polsku): [Narzędzia PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/), [Edytuj PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/edytuj-pdf), [Podpisz PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/podpisz-pdf), [Wypełnij formularz PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/wypelnij-formularz-pdf), [Numeracja stron](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/numeracja-stron-pdf), [Znak wodny](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/znak-wodny-pdf), [Metadane PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/edytuj-metadane-pdf), [Połącz PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/polacz-pdf), [Podziel PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/podziel-pdf), [Kolejność stron](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/zmien-kolejnosc-stron-pdf), [Obróć PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/obroc-pdf), [Kompresuj PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/kompresuj-pdf), [OCR PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/ocr-pdf), [JPG do PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/jpg-do-pdf), [PDF do JPG](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/pdf-do-jpg), [PDF do tekstu](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/pdf-do-tekstu), [PDF do Word](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/pdf-do-word), [Word do PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/word-do-pdf), [Zabezpiecz PDF hasłem](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/zabezpiecz-pdf-haslem), [Odblokuj PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/odblokuj-pdf), [Anonimizuj PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/anonimizuj-pdf), [Porównaj PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/porownaj-pdf), [Kompresja zdjęć](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/kompresuj-zdjecia), [Usuń tło](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/usun-tlo), [HEIC do JPG](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/heic-do-jpg), [Generator kodów QR](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/generator-kodow-qr).

## Guides

- [How to check a PDF redaction really removed the text](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/check-pdf-redaction): copy-paste, search and pdftotext checks; comments, forms and metadata.
- [How to sign a PDF without uploading it](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/sign-pdf-without-uploading): drawn, typed or scanned signature in the browser; simple vs qualified signatures (eIDAS art. 25, US ESIGN Act).
- [How to check and remove hidden PDF metadata](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/remove-pdf-metadata): information dictionary and XMP, pdfinfo and exiftool checks, what Edit metadata removes and what it keeps.
- [How to compress a PDF to send it by e-mail](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/compress-pdf-for-email): e-mail size limits and base64 overhead, lossless vs image levels, what compression cannot shrink.
- [How to convert HEIC photos to JPG without uploading them](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/heic-to-jpg-without-uploading): batch conversion in the browser, quality and resize settings, EXIF removal, Apple's settings to avoid HEIC.
- [How to convert a PDF to Word without uploading it](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/pdf-to-word-without-uploading): what carries over to .docx and what does not (tables, columns, images, fonts), OCR first for scans.
- [How to check if a PDF tool uploads your files](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/does-a-pdf-tool-upload-your-files): watch the network panel, run the tool with the connection off, read the Content-Security-Policy; which privacy claims prove nothing.
- [How to merge PDFs without uploading them](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/merge-pdf-without-uploading): merging in the browser in the order you choose, and what a merge drops: bookmarks, form fields, signatures and document properties.
- [Why text copied from a PDF pastes as gibberish](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/pdf-text-pastes-as-gibberish): telling four causes apart in one click, the ToUnicode CMap, why converting to Word does not help, and the skip setting that decides whether OCR does anything.
- [Why phone photos come out sideways in a PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/photos-sideways-in-pdf): the EXIF orientation tag, why rotating pages afterwards is the wrong fix, and the page size, orientation and margin settings for building the PDF correctly.
- [How to remove a password from a PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/remove-pdf-password): telling an open password from a permissions password, the empty password box that undoes the second, and why no tool recovers one you do not know.
- [How to password-protect a PDF without uploading it](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/guides/password-protect-pdf): AES-256 in the browser, the password against the owner password, and the two permissions that are granted whatever you tick.
- [Anonimizacja dokumentów PDF zgodnie z RODO](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/anonimizacja-pdf-rodo) (Polish): anonymisation vs pseudonymisation, verification, checklist for CVs and contracts.
- [Anonimizacja dokumentów w BIP szkoły: jak sprawdzić, czy zaczernienie działa](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/anonimizacja-bip-szkola) (Polish): what goes into a school's public information bulletin, why a black rectangle in Word or a PDF often hides nothing, and five checks before publishing.
- [OCR skanów i łączenie dokumentów klienta bez wysyłania do chmury](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/ocr-i-laczenie-dokumentow-bez-chmury) (Polish): scans into one searchable Polish PDF, then merge, shrink for e-mail and lock with a password, all in the browser.
- [Jak podpisać PDF w przeglądarce bez wysyłania pliku](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/podpis-pdf-bez-wysylania) (Polish): image signature as a simple electronic signature (eIDAS art. 25) vs podpis zaufany and podpis kwalifikowany; when Polish law requires which (Kodeks cywilny art. 78¹).
- [Jak zamienić zdjęcia HEIC na JPG bez wysyłania ich na serwer](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/heic-do-jpg-bez-wysylania) (Polish): what HEIC is, batch conversion in the browser, what happens to EXIF, what the tool will not do, and how to stop an iPhone producing HEIC.
- [Jak zamienić PDF na Word bez wysyłania pliku](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/pdf-do-word-bez-wysylania) (Polish): what carries over into .docx and what does not, why a scan needs OCR first, and Polish characters in the result.
- [Jak zmniejszyć PDF, żeby zmieścił się w e-mailu](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/kompresja-pdf-do-emaila) (Polish): attachment limits at Gmail, Outlook, WP, o2 and Interia, base64 overhead, and which compression level destroys the text layer.
- [Jak połączyć pliki PDF bez wysyłania ich na serwer](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/polacz-pdf-bez-wysylania) (Polish): merging in the browser in the chosen order, and what a merge drops: bookmarks, form fields, signatures and metadata.
- [Ukryte metadane w PDF: co widzi odbiorca dokumentu](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/metadane-pdf-bip-rodo) (Polish): the information dictionary and the XMP packet, how to check both, why clearing the fields is not enough, and what Polish accessibility law actually requires.
- [Jak usunąć hasło z wyciągu bankowego, nie wysyłając go na obcy serwer](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/haslo-wyciag-bankowy) (Polish): the difference between an open password and a permissions password, removing either in the browser, why the tool cannot crack an unknown password, and what to redact before sending a statement on.
- [Jak zabezpieczyć PDF hasłem, zanim wyślesz go z danymi osobowymi](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/zabezpiecz-pdf-przed-wyslaniem) (Polish): encryption as a measure named in GDPR art. 32(1)(a), why server-side "protect" tools need the unprotected file first, user vs owner password, AES-256 (/V 5, /R 6, /AESV3), what permission flags cannot enforce, and sending the password on a separate channel.
- [Jak podzielić zbiorczy skan na osobne dokumenty, nie wysyłając go nikomu](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/podziel-skan-na-dokumenty) (Polish): splitting a feeder scan in the browser instead of installing desktop software, the three modes (every page, ranges, extract), how the output files are named, why the parts can add up to more than the original, and what to do with them next.
- [Jak zrobić jeden PDF ze zdjęć dokumentów zrobionych telefonem](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/zdjecia-dokumentow-do-pdf) (Polish): phone photos into one PDF, one per page, in an order you drag; page size, orientation and margin options; why EXIF rotation makes photos come out sideways elsewhere and not here; and what to do with the file next.
- [Jak wypełnić formularz PDF, żeby polskie znaki nie zniknęły](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/wypelnij-formularz-pdf) (Polish): telling a form with real fields from a flat page, why the 14 standard PDF fonts drop ą ę ł so filled forms lose their Polish characters, regenerating field appearances with an embedded font, when to flatten, and what to do when the form has no fields at all.
- [Jak skopiować tekst z PDF, z którego nie da się go zaznaczyć](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/skopiuj-tekst-z-pdf) (Polish): one click that separates the four causes, a scan with no text layer, a copy-protection flag that extraction ignores anyway, a broken character map that makes text paste as nonsense (run OCR with "skip pages that already have text" unticked), and a file that needs a password to open at all.
- [Jak zmniejszyć zdjęcie przed wysłaniem i usunąć z niego lokalizację](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/zmniejsz-zdjecie-i-usun-exif) (Polish): what EXIF carries including GPS coordinates, why the tool has no "remove EXIF" button (the file is rebuilt from pixels, so there is nothing left to remove, though the rotation is applied on the way), quality and dimension settings, and how to hit a form's size limit.
- [Jak znaleźć zmiany między dwiema wersjami umowy w PDF](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/porownaj-wersje-umowy-pdf) (Polish): comparing a contract against its returned version without uploading either, the line diff and the pixel diff and why neither is enough alone, what counts as a change, and why two separate scans light up everywhere.
- [Jak oznaczyć skan dowodu osobistego, zanim go komuś wyślesz](https://tools.nyxiontech.com/pl/poradnik/znak-wodny-na-skanie-dowodu) (Polish): asking for the legal basis first (UODO fined ING Bank Śląski 18,416,400 zł in August 2025 for scanning ID documents without a purpose analysis), writing a watermark that states recipient, purpose and date, Polish diacritics in the watermark, and why covering a PESEL on a scan only works once the page is rasterised.

## Frequently asked questions

- Are my files uploaded? No. Every tool runs in your browser on your own device; the files never leave it. The page loads its code once from tools.nyxiontech.com and makes no other requests.
- Is it free? Yes, with no limits, sign-up or watermarks. It is open source under the GNU AGPL v3. Donations are welcome at https://ko-fi.com/nyxiontech.
- Does it work offline? The Windows app works fully offline. The web version needs a connection to load a tool's files (for example the OCR language data) the first time you use it.
- How do I make a scanned PDF searchable? Use "OCR: searchable PDF". It adds an invisible text layer over the unchanged page images.
- How do I sign a PDF for free? Open "Sign PDF", draw, type or upload your signature and place it on the page, then download.
- Is redaction safe? Yes. Pages with redactions are re-rendered as images with the boxes burnt in, so the hidden text is removed, not just covered.
- Which alternatives does it replace? Online services such as iLovePDF, Smallpdf or Adobe Acrobat online for everyday tasks, without uploading documents.
